mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.store_id, s.name AS store_name, r.member_id, m.name AS member_name, r.comment, r.created_at, r.grade, r.is_deleted FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN stores s ON s.id = r.store_id LEFT JOIN members m ON m.id = r.member_id WHERE r.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY r.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE reviews SET store_id = #{review.storeId}, member_id = #{review.memberId}, comment = #{review.comment}, grade = #{review.grade} WHERE id = #{review.id} AND is_deleted = FALSE

UPDATE reviews SET is_deleted = TRUE WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND id IN
#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews ( store_id, member_id, comment, created_at, grade, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{review.storeId}, #{review.memberId}, #{review.comment}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{review.grade}, FALSE )
mapper.select: SELECT name FROM stores WHERE id = #{storeId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
